properties.to_note: Khartoum is the seat of the regime only after it was founded in the 1820s. For the 1821 Sennar capitulation (rel-funj-05) and the 1822 Shendi revolt (rel-jaaliyyin-03) the anchor is a symbol of the regime, not where its forces stood. Al-Zubayr was a trader active in Bahr al-Ghazal, not based in Khartoum; for rel-fur-06 the anchor stands for the regime only.
properties.label_en: In late October 1822, after Isma'il demanded a heavy levy at Shendi and struck Mak Nimir, Nimir and his men burned Isma'il and his staff; the revolt spread to other regions.
properties.label_ar: في أواخر أكتوبر 1822، بعد أن فرض إسماعيل إتاوة باهظة في شندي وأهان المك نمر، أحرق نمر ورجاله إسماعيل وحاشيته، وامتدت الثورة إلى مناطق أخرى. [Arabic text pending native-speaker review.]
